args.description: holds an invisible opponent in front of him with both hands, arms extended and fists closed on empty air, breathing calmly, a seamless loop. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy white hair and blue eyes, a long white coat with grey tails, a black shirt, black trousers and grey boots
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of him with both hands
